issues.legal_issue: The phrase “by the direction of the testator” in Section 63(c) of the Indian Succession Act applies when an attesting witness sees another person sign the will, and does not apply when the witness sees the testator sign or affix a mark to it.

A will satisfies the attestation requirement in Section 63(c) when an attesting witness testifies to seeing the testator affix a mark to the will, even if the witness does not testify that the mark was affixed at the testator’s direction.
The will was validly proved, and the subsequent sale deeds executed on its basis were valid.
